I loved your talk. Thanks so much for coming to see us. I now understand when and why one would want to invest in the learning curve for those inversion of control containers or whatever it is that replaces hand-made factories in large systems.
I’m so busy with SharePoint Designer right now, I don’t have time for these things. But when I get back to Visual Studio and ASP.Net, I hope to try some of the mvccontrib ideas.
